[6:53AM] #LagIbdExpWay
#3MB
#TrafficUpdate

We are currently experiencing a fast traffic flow inward Berger from Kara end all the way to Tollgate for now.
7up, China town, Estate down to Iyana Oworo is also still an encouraging Vehicular movement.
Aside from a slight delay at Iyana Oworo bus stop due to vehicles trying to access the layby, connecting the Third mainland bridge all the way to Adeniji is also still good to go.

Adeniji through Ilubirin inward Sura , Obalende bridge and Descending to Onikan roundabout and also Flag house is also still moving well.

 Flag house  enroute CMS bridge to connect Apongbon bridge is in good shape for now.

Likewise Apongbon bridge descending to outer Marina, CMS to Train station looks good.

The return journey back to the Third mainland bridge en route Iyana Oworo is free.
#FollowLASTMA

[7:08AM]  #IjuRd
#CollegeRd
#TrafficUpdate

Traffic is still an encouraging one Ishaga bus stop towards Fagba.
It moves slowly from Alamutu towards Fagba intersection due to morning influx of Vehicular movement, bus stop activities and ongoing alternation at Fagba.

Inward and outward of Jonathan Coker is fair.

Fagba moving ahead to Jungle, Ifako international looks good except for the traffic light alternation delay.

Proceeding towards Pen Cinema looks good upto Odejobi junction, then moves slowly towards the alternation point due to ongoing alternation,  activities of the commercial tricycles and commercial buses.

The return journey back to Fagba and Ishaga is better.

College road from Ifako General hospital down to Excellence hotel and the return journey looks good for now.
#FollowLASTMA
